hardcoded_secret.intent: hardcoded credentials that would leak if committed

real_secret.instructions: Is this matched string a credential that would leak if committed?

criteria.true: live key, token, password, or private key material for a real system or third-party service
criteria.false: placeholder, test fixture, example value, documentation sample, or local-only default

slop_comment.intent: AI slop comments: narration that restates the code instead of explaining why

is_slop.instructions: Is this comment AI slop (narrates what the code does, step-by-step filler) rather than a substantive why?

criteria.true: restates the adjacent code, narrates execution steps, or is filler with no information content
criteria.false: explains a reason, constraint, tradeoff, caveat, or decision the code cannot show

severity.instructions: How damaging is this comment to a maintainer? (0=cosmetic .. 2=misleading)
criteria: cosmetic phrasing; intent of the code is still clear
narrates what the code does; nothing would be lost if the comment were deleted
actively misleads the reader or masks a missing decision

rust_test_no_assert.intent: tests that execute code without verifying any behavior

no_verification.instructions: Does this test function fail to verify any behavior (no assert, no mock verification, no panic or checked-result check)?

criteria.true: the test only executes code and would still pass if the behavior under test were broken
criteria.false: it verifies through assert!/assert_eq!/assert_ne!, mock expectations, should_panic, or unwraps a checked result

antislop.intent: AI slop in code: unfinished-work markers, deferrals, hedges, empty stubs

slop_violation.instructions: Is this matched token a real slop violation (unfinished-work marker, deferral, hedge, or empty stub left in the code) rather than legitimate use?

criteria.true: The token marks unfinished/deferred/hedged work with no tracking: bare TODO/FIXME without an issue reference, a 'for now' deferral, a 'should work' hedge, or an empty function body
criteria.false: Legitimate use: TODO with an issue reference (repo convention TODO(#123)), placeholder/stub as a documented API concept or test fixture, or the word used in normal prose or an identifier

slop_severity.instructions: How damaging is this token to a maintainer reading the code?
criteria: Cosmetic: legitimate use or trivial wording; nothing to fix
Misleading: deferral or hedge that reads like a decision but defers one
Blocking signal: bare unfinished-work marker or empty stub shipped in code

duplication.intent: copy-paste drift: the same block introduced more than once within this change

real_duplication.instructions: Is this repeated block harmful duplication that should be extracted or shared, rather than coincidental or idiomatic similarity?

criteria.true: Same or near-same logic lines repeated across locations; a fix to one would need the same fix in the others
criteria.false: Similarity is structural boilerplate (imports, trait/struct declarations, test scaffolding, standard match arms) or the blocks differ in essential logic

dup_severity.instructions: How much drift risk does this duplication carry?
criteria: Coincidental or idiomatic: no shared logic, no extraction needed
Extractable: 4-10 duplicated lines with real logic; changes must be mirrored
High risk: large or logic-bearing block duplicated across files with divergent-fix danger
